gate: if [ -f package.json ]; then pnpm gate; fi

checks.run: pnpm --filter ./packages/query lint && pnpm --filter ./packages/query typecheck && pnpm --filter ./packages/query test
pnpm --filter ./apps/server lint && pnpm --filter ./apps/server typecheck && pnpm --filter ./apps/server test
pnpm --filter ./apps/web lint && pnpm --filter ./apps/web typecheck && pnpm --filter ./apps/web test && pnpm --filter ./apps/web build

bootstrap: if [ -f pnpm-lock.yaml ]; then pnpm install --frozen-lockfile; fi

areas.name: area:server
areas.description: HTTP app, API routes, jobs interface, config — apps/server

areas.name: area:auth
areas.description: GitHub App OAuth, setup flow, sessions, token encryption — apps/server/src/auth

areas.name: area:sync
areas.description: Sync, webhooks, reconciliation, GitHub client — apps/server/src/{sync,webhooks,github}

areas.name: area:db
areas.description: Drizzle schema and migrations, access scoping — apps/server/src/db

areas.name: area:query
areas.description: Filter parser and evaluator shared by server and web — packages/query

areas.name: area:web
areas.description: React SPA: list, boards, detail panel — apps/web

risk.name: safety-critical
risk.description: Auth, tokens, webhooks, sanitizing, access scoping, migrations: maintainer reads the diff

maintainerOnly.name: maintainer-only
maintainerOnly.description: Needs the maintainer: GitHub App registration, Coolify, secrets, DNS
